Engineer Q. O'Bannon - GENSEC Level 04
Maintenance Request GDM-017-386P

Issue: Fire Damage (Wall Panels, Floor, Ceiling)
Location: Laboratory (Underbelly)
Current Status: Fixed

Notes:
A fire in the laboratory caused extensive damage to one of the R&D areas. Thank goodness nobody was injured. Had to spend a week elbow-deep in melted plastic and carbonized metal doing demolition and then about three days replacing the walls, ceiling, and floor panels. These experiments are really getting out of hand. Is anyone practicing safety down there? Does C.T. Bayu even care?
